detailed_scenario_results.name: Tomato Early Blight under Clear Weather

authoritative_reference.source: ICAR Kharif Agro-Advisories for Farmers 2025 (p. 86) & TNAU CPG 2024
authoritative_reference.guideline: For tomato early blight (Alternaria solani), apply foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L with 200-250 L water/acre. Repeat at 10-14 day intervals.
authoritative_reference.safety_mandates: Pre-harvest interval 5 days; Re-entry interval 24 hours; Wear nitrile gloves and mist respirator.

safety_constraints: Rule F (Conflict Resolution Guard): 1 active conflict(s) detected. Recommendation constrained to safe agronomic action.
actual_output.authority_reference: TNAU Crop Production Guide 2024 & ICAR Kharif Advisory 2025 (p. 86)

detailed_scenario_results.reviewer_notes: Standard happy path for tomato early blight in Haryana under dry weather conditions.
detailed_scenario_results.unresolved_ambiguity: None. Dosage and chemical formulation are CIBRC approved.
